# gyro_dns_zone (Resource)

A zone on Gyro DNS (ns1.gyrodns.net / ns2.gyrodns.net). The zone is published after ownership is verified: delegate the domain to the name servers (immediate if already delegated) or create the TXT record `verification_txt_name` = `verification_txt_value` at your current DNS. `status` is `active` or `pending`. Destroy removes the zone and its records.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gyro_dns_zone" "example" {
  service_id = 789 # Gyro DNS service
  name       = "example.com"
  dnssec     = true
}

# Point the domain to the name servers (or create the TXT record) to activate the zone
output "nameservers" { value = gyro_dns_zone.example.nameservers }
output "verify_txt" { value = "${gyro_dns_zone.example.verification_txt_name} = ${gyro_dns_zone.example.verification_txt_value}" }
output "ds" { value = gyro_dns_zone.example.ds_records }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Zone (domain) name.
- `service_id` (Number) Gyro DNS service id.

### Optional

- `dnssec` (Boolean) Sign the zone. Enter `ds_records` at your registrar afterwards; remove them there before disabling.
- `zone_file` (String) Optional BIND zone file imported once when the zone is created (SOA and apex NS are ignored). Later changes are not applied; manage records with gyro_dns_record.

### Read-Only

- `ds_records` (List of String) DS records for the registrar (when dnssec = true).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nameservers` (List of String)
- `status` (String) active or pending (ownership not verified yet).
- `verification_txt_name` (String)
- `verification_txt_value` (String) TXT value proving ownership (pending zones; empty once active).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <service_id>/<zone>
terraform import gyro_dns_zone.example 789/example.com
```
